session_summary: As the Explorer & Collector, I ran through Gloomwood Hollow, gathering 25 coins upon completion and successfully investing in the 'trail_cap' cosmetic from the marketplace. The run felt straightforward, but highlighted the ongoing need for a dedicated discovery ledger and reasons to re-explore completed paths.

observations.evidence: Completed Gloomwood Hollow route and received standard coin payout, but found no in-game ledger or tracking for collected items like Gloomcaps or Root Relics.
observations.recommendation: Prioritize the Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI backlog item to give collectors a visual tracker for route completions and rare drops.

observations.evidence: Successfully purchased and equipped the 'trail_cap' cosmetic for 45 coins, leaving 88 coins in the wallet.
observations.recommendation: Introduce more diverse cosmetic categories (e.g., trails, capes, auras) and route-specific outfit drops to increase long-term collection incentives.

observations.evidence: Gloomwood Hollow features collectibles like 'Gloomcap' and 'Root Relic', but gameplay trace shows standard walking/jumping/combat without interactive collection events for these unique items.
observations.recommendation: Add distinct interactive collection nodes or hidden side paths within routes to make gathering thematic items more rewarding for explorers.

feature_requests.title: Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI
feature_requests.player_value: Allows collectors to track completion percentages, unique items found per route, and unlock milestone cosmetic rewards.
feature_requests.rationale: Currently, completing routes like Gloomwood Hollow gives coins, but lacks a centralized interface to showcase collection progress and encourage re-playing routes.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: An accessible in-game UI ledger displaying route completion tallies, collected unique items (like Gloomcaps or Moon Sigils), and reward milestones.

feature_requests.title: Route-Specific Secret Chambers and Lore Collectibles
feature_requests.player_value: Gives players strong narrative and exploratory incentives to revisit routes multiple times.
feature_requests.rationale: As an explorer, once a route is finished, there are few gameplay reasons to replay it other than grinding standard currency.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add optional secret branch paths or lore fragments into existing routes (such as Ember Forge or Gloomwood Hollow) that reward players with unique thematic cosmetics or codex entries upon discovery.

keep: Smooth marketplace purchasing and automatic cosmetic equipping upon purchase.
The rich thematic variety of route settings (e.g., Gloomwood's twilight forest and Ember Forge's ash and iron).
Clear and responsive telemetry tracking for route start and completion events.
focus: route variety, discoveries, collectibles, cosmetics, reasons to revisit routes
